_meta.batch: Examine - lokacja Parlor (205 terminow, ~45 mikroscen) - interakcje z otoczeniem w Salonie (glownym hubie lodzi podwodnej), w tym finalowa sekwencja pogoni za Grippem po ujawnieniu go jako mordercy (GrippHasEscaped, GrippTurnedOffLights) oraz krotkie reakcje kazdego z 8 podejrzanych podczas finalowej konfrontacji w Salonie (Parlor_[Postac] 1/2/3).
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json NIE POKRYWA kategorii Examine. Mowcy przypisani na podstawie kontekstu/tresci (nazwa sceny czesto wskazuje ktora postac - np. 'Parlor_Gripp 1' = rozmowa z Grippem, wiec jego linie = Gripp, pozostale = Grimoire/Sally naprzemiennie wedlug logiki dialogu). Do weryfikacji w grze przy watpliwosciach.
_meta.uwagi: Exam_Area_Parlor_bg/ds4 zawiera angielska gre slowna 'drawing room'/'withdrawing room' (etymologia 'pokoju do wycofywania sie') nieprzekladalna doslownie na polski 'salon' - przetlumaczona funkcjonalnie z zachowaniem sensu wyjasnienia.

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_BGGripp/Section.en: I think we'd better talk to Gripp.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_BGGripp/Section.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomLock.en: I think this door leads into the control room.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomLock.pl: Myślę, że te drzwi prowadzą do centrali dowodzenia.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomLock.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomLock.en: I wanna go into the control room!
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomLock.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.en: Did you talk to Sym yet?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.speaker: Sinthia

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.en: She'll be in the room nearest the Illusion Theatre.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.pl: Będzie w pokoju najbliżej Teatru Iluzji.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.speaker: Sinthia

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.en: Did you talk to Sym yet?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.speaker: Sinthia

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.en: She'll be in the room nearest the Illusion Theatre.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.pl: Będzie w pokoju najbliżej Teatru Iluzji.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.speaker: Sinthia

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.en: The Child's Room? The one with that weird painting?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.pl: Pokój Dziecka? Ten z tym dziwnym obrazem?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.en: Yeah, no - there's no [i]weird painting[/i] in that room. Just a weird [h]girl.[/h]
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.pl: Tak, nie - nie ma żadnego [i]dziwnego obrazu[/i] w tym pokoju. Tylko dziwna [h]dziewczyna.[/h]
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.speaker: Sinthia

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.en: Tell her to knock it off and start taking this seriously.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.pl: Powiedzcie jej, żeby przestała i zaczęła traktować to poważnie.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.speaker: Sinthia

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.en: I'm not about to declare her innocent right here, right now - if [i]that's[/i] what you were hoping for.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.pl: Nie zamierzam ogłaszać jej niewinności tu i teraz - jeśli [i]na to[/i] liczyliście.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.en: We haven't even spoken to all the [i]suspects[/i] yet.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.pl: Nie rozmawialiśmy jeszcze nawet ze wszystkimi [i]podejrzanymi.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.en: Oh, which ones are you missing?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomSint.speaker: Sinthia

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomUnlo.en: Looks like she unlocked the door...
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomUnlo.pl: Wygląda na to, że otworzyła drzwi...
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomUnlo.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomWind.en: It's a window into the control room.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomWind.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomWind.en: It's taped up on the other side of the door.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomWind.pl: Jest przyklejona po drugiej stronie drzwi.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomWind.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomWind.en: [i]You don't need to come in here.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomWind.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomWind.en: [i]The crime scene is one floor down, at the very back of the submarine.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomWind.pl: [i]Miejsce zbrodni jest piętro niżej, na samym tyle łodzi podwodnej.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomWind.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomWind.en: Thanks for the directions, I guess...
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomWind.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomWind.en: Do you get the sense that the Captain is [h]hiding[/h] from us?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomWind.pl: Masz wrażenie, że Kapitan się przed nami [h]ukrywa?[/h]
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ControlRoomWind.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Dirk 1/Section.en: Oh man, I thought you guys were like - [h]gone[/h] gone.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Dirk 1/Section.pl: O rany, myślałem, że wy dwoje jesteście jakby - [h]zniknęli[/h] na dobre.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Dirk 1/Section.speaker: Dirk

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Dirk 1/Section.en: It's only been about an hour...
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Dirk 1/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Dirk 1/Section.en: I'm not sure Dirk's developed object permanence yet.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Dirk 1/Section.pl: Nie jestem pewna, czy Dirk ma już wykształconą stałość przedmiotu.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Dirk 1/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Dirk 1/Section.en: I don't know what that means. But I'm gonna assume you're being rude!
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Dirk 1/Section.pl: Nie wiem, co to znaczy. Ale założę się, że jesteś niemiła!
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Dirk 1/Section.speaker: Dirk

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Dirk 2/Section.en: I got a feeling something [i]bad[/i] is about to go down.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Dirk 2/Section.pl: Mam przeczucie, że zaraz stanie się coś [i]złego.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Dirk 2/Section.speaker: Dirk

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Dirk 3/Section.en: Uh - what happens now? We call the cops, or what?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Dirk 3/Section.pl: Yy - co teraz? Dzwonimy na policję, czy co?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Dirk 3/Section.speaker: Dirk

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_FirstEntry/Sect.en: What's at the bottom of the ladder?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_FirstEntry/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_FirstEntry/Sect.en: I can't see, it's pitch black.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_FirstEntry/Sect.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_FirstEntry/Sect.en: Wait, I think there's a lever-
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_FirstEntry/Sect.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Gripp 1/Section.en: Yup. All wrapped up with a bow.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Gripp 1/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Gripp 1/Section.en: What now - dramatically [i]point[/i] at the culprit? [i]'Ha haa, it's you'[/i] - etcetera?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Gripp 1/Section.pl: Co teraz - dramatycznie [i]wskazać[/i] winnego? [i]'Ha haa, to ty'[/i] - i tak dalej?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Gripp 1/Section.speaker: Gripp

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Gripp 1/Section.en: Uh, that's not - normally our standard protocol, no.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Gripp 1/Section.pl: Yy, to nie - normalnie nasz standardowy protokół, nie.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Gripp 1/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Gripp 2/Section.en: ...Mortuga had such a thing hidden in the submarine, this whole time.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Gripp 2/Section.pl: ...że Mortuga miał coś takiego ukrytego na łodzi podwodnej, przez cały ten czas.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Gripp 2/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_GrippHasEscaped.en: He can't have gone up to the Fore Deck, it's still locked-
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_GrippHasEscaped.pl: Nie mógł pójść na Pokład Dziobowy, wciąż jest zamknięty-
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_GrippHasEscaped.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_GrippHasEscaped.en: Let's go! Maybe we can catch him!
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_GrippHasEscaped.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 1/Section.en: I can't say I [i]like[/i] being locked inside the submarine...
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 1/Section.pl: Nie mogę powiedzieć, żebym [i]lubiła[/i] być zamknięta na łodzi podwodnej...
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 1/Section.speaker: Moon

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 1/Section.en: You feel like you might want to try to escape?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 1/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 1/Section.en: You [i]couldn't[/i] escape, even [h]if[/h] the Fore Deck hatch was open-
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 1/Section.pl: Nie [i]mogłabyś[/i] uciec, nawet [h]gdyby[/h] właz na Pokładzie Dziobowym był otwarty-
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 1/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 1/Section.en: -we're floating in the middle of the ocean.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 1/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 1/Section.en: Ah, but what if I've chartered a [i]rescue helicopter??[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 1/Section.pl: Ach, ale co jeśli wynajęłam [i]helikopter ratunkowy??[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 1/Section.speaker: Moon

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 2/Section.en: You're asking for trouble, you know that?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 2/Section.pl: Prosisz się o kłopoty, wiesz o tym?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 2/Section.speaker: Moon

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 2/Section.en: Don't say I didn't warn you.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 2/Section.pl: Nie mów, że cię nie ostrzegałam.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 2/Section.speaker: Moon

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 3/Section.pl: Fascynujące... ale nie do końca niespodziewane.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 3/Section.speaker: Moon

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 3/Section.en: Oh no? You had it sussed out?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 3/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 3/Section.en: You coulda [i]told[/i] us. Saved us some time.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 3/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 3/Section.en: -and what if I'd been wrong? Hm?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 3/Section.pl: -a co, jeśli bym się myliła? Hm?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Moon 3/Section.speaker: Moon

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_NoDirections/Se.en:
Hang on.
Which way is the crime scene?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_NoDirections/Se.pl:
Czekaj.
W którą stronę jest miejsce zbrodni?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_NoDirections/Se.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_NoDirections/Se.en: I'm not sure that's a good idea.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_NoDirections/Se.pl: Nie jestem pewna, czy to dobry pomysł.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_NoDirections/Se.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_NoDirections/Se.en: I assumed we were just going to wander around randomly until we found it.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_NoDirections/Se.pl: Zakładałem, że po prostu będziemy się błąkać na oślep, aż to znajdziemy.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_NoDirections/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Sally 1/Section.en: This is - the [i]weirdest[/i] submarine I've ever been on.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Sally 1/Section.pl: To jest - [i]najdziwniejsza[/i] łódź podwodna, na jakiej kiedykolwiek byłam.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Sally 1/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Sinthia 1/Secti.en: That's exactly what people say when they [i]don't have everything under control.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Sinthia 1/Secti.pl: To dokładnie to, co ludzie mówią, kiedy [i]nie mają wszystkiego pod kontrolą.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Sinthia 1/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Sinthia 3/Secti.en: [i]...what do we do? What do I do?[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Sinthia 3/Secti.speaker: Sinthia

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Sinthia 3/Secti.en: ...should I put him in the brig?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Sinthia 3/Secti.speaker: Sinthia

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Sinthia 3/Secti.en: I - was thinking maybe we could use one of the bunk rooms... we could lock it from the outside...
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Sinthia 3/Secti.pl: Ja - myślałam, że może moglibyśmy użyć jednej z kajut sypialnych... moglibyśmy zamknąć ją z zewnątrz...
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Sinthia 3/Secti.speaker: Sinthia

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Sinthia 3/Secti.en: Let's cross that brig when we come to it.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Sinthia 3/Secti.pl: Zajmiemy się aresztem, kiedy przyjdzie na to czas.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Sinthia 3/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Speaker/Section.en: There's an old-fashioned speaker mounted on the wall. It's playing spooky music.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Speaker/Section.pl: Na ścianie zamontowano staromodny głośnik. Gra z niego niesamowita muzyka.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Speaker/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Speaker/Section.en: It's the kind of music you'd hear at a fancy party for vampires...
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Speaker/Section.pl: To rodzaj muzyki, jaką usłyszałbyś na wystawnym przyjęciu dla wampirów...
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Speaker/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Speaker/Section.en: -but the vampires are all wearing masks, and there's one guy who's secretly [h]not[/h] a vampire, and-
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Speaker/Section.pl: -ale wszystkie wampiry noszą maski, i jest jeden facet, który potajemnie [h]nie[/h] jest wampirem, i-
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Speaker/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Symmetry 1/Sect.en: I know thy task is grave, but use a gentle hand, for we are [i]frail and fragile[/i] souls.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Symmetry 1/Sect.pl: Wiem, że wasze zadanie poważne jest, lecz łagodną dłoń zachowajcie, bo jesteśmy [i]słabymi, kruchymi[/i] duszami.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Symmetry 1/Sect.speaker: Symmetry

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Symmetry 2/Sect.en: ...waiting for one of us to act...
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Symmetry 2/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Symmetry 3/Sect.en: The mask dropped, and truth stands bare revealed.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Symmetry 3/Sect.pl: Maska opadła, a prawda stoi obnażona.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Symmetry 3/Sect.speaker: Symmetry

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Tadpole 1/Secti.en: What's the hold up? We're all here, aren't we?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Tadpole 1/Secti.pl: Co nas wstrzymuje? Wszyscy tu jesteśmy, prawda?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Tadpole 1/Secti.speaker: Tadpole

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Tadpole 2/Secti.en: It's the mask that was stolen from my room...
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Tadpole 2/Secti.pl: To maska, która została skradziona z mojego pokoju...
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Tadpole 2/Secti.speaker: Tadpole

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Tadpole 3/Secti.en: What are you going to do?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Tadpole 3/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Tadpole 3/Secti.en: Uh - actually, it might be better if you don't answer that.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Tadpole 3/Secti.pl: Yy - właściwie, może lepiej, żebyś nie odpowiadała na to pytanie.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Tadpole 3/Secti.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Wirman 1/Sectio.en: You know, we really do have the [i]perfect[/i] setting for this - in terms of literary tradition, I mean.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Wirman 1/Sectio.pl: Wiecie, mamy naprawdę [i]idealną[/i] scenerię do tego - w sensie tradycji literackiej, mam na myśli.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Wirman 1/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Wirman 2/Sectio.en: ...I thought I knew all [i]about[/i] Mortuga, but this [i]mask[/i] thing?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Wirman 2/Sectio.pl: ...myślałem, że wiem wszystko [i]o[/i] Mortudze, ale ta sprawa z [i]maską?[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Wirman 2/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Wirman 2/Sectio.en: I dunno. I feel like maybe I missed a memo.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Wirman 2/Sectio.pl: Nie wiem. Mam wrażenie, że coś mi umknęło.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Wirman 2/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Wirman 3/Sectio.en: Ah - [i]the villain reveals himself.[/i] Another classic literary trope.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Wirman 3/Sectio.pl: Ach - [i]złoczyńca się odsłania.[/i] Kolejny klasyczny motyw literacki.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Wirman 3/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Wirman 3/Sectio.en: Let me guess - he's about to monologue about why he did it?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Wirman 3/Sectio.pl: Niech zgadnę - zaraz wygłosi monolog, dlaczego to zrobił?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Wirman 3/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Wirman 3/Sectio.en: I'd be disappointed if he didn't!
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Wirman 3/Sectio.pl: Byłbym rozczarowany, gdyby tego nie zrobił!
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Wirman 3/Sectio.speaker: Wirman

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Zephyr 1/Sectio.en: [i]You[/i] have been inside my Cabinet of Curiosity.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Zephyr 1/Sectio.speaker: Zephyr

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Zephyr 1/Sectio.en: The guilt is written on your face, you refuse to meet my eye.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Zephyr 1/Sectio.pl: Wina jest wypisana na twojej twarzy, unikasz mojego wzroku.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Zephyr 1/Sectio.speaker: Zephyr

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Zephyr 3/Sectio.en: He stands exposed at last... and witnessed by no less than a [i]full court of his peers.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Zephyr 3/Sectio.pl: Stoi wreszcie obnażony... świadkiem czego jest nie kto inny, jak [i]pełny dwór jego rówieśników.[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Zephyr 3/Sectio.speaker: Zephyr

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Zephyr 3/Sectio.en: I wonder - is it bravery, or surrender?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Zephyr 3/Sectio.pl: Zastanawiam się - czy to odwaga, czy poddanie się?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Zephyr 3/Sectio.speaker: Zephyr

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Zephyr 3/Sectio.en: Yeah well, we kinda backed him into a corner. Literally.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Zephyr 3/Sectio.pl: No cóż, trochę zapędziliśmy go w kąt. Dosłownie.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_Zephyr 3/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_bg/Section ds2.en: It's like an old fashioned drawing room...
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_bg/Section ds2.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_bg/Section ds4.en: It's short for [h]with[/h]drawing. As in, you [h]withdraw[/h] there after dinner.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_bg/Section ds4.pl: To skrót od pokoju do [h]wy[/h]cofywania się. Bo [h]wycofujesz[/h] się tam po kolacji.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_bg/Section ds4.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_bg/Section ds5.pl: Ja... właściwie nigdy tego nie wiedziałam.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_bg/Section ds5.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_books/Section d.en:
[i]Mysteries of the Deep.
Wonders of the Ocean Depths.
Secrets of the Darkest, Deepest-[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_books/Section d.pl:
[i]Tajemnice Głębin.
Cuda Oceanicznych Głębi.
Sekrety Najciemniejszych, Najgłębszych-[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_books/Section d.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_books/Section d.en: What kind of books have we got?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_books/Section d.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_books/Section d.en: Okay - it's safe to say a clear theme is emerging.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_books/Section d.pl: Okej - można śmiało powiedzieć, że wyłania się wyraźny motyw.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_books/Section d.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_chandelier/Sect.en: I'm guessing this place hasn't booked its quarterly fire safety inspection.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_chandelier/Sect.pl: Zgaduję, że to miejsce nie umówiło się na kwartalną kontrolę przeciwpożarową.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_chandelier/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_chandelier/Sect.en:
The candles are actually lit.
Some of them anyway.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_chandelier/Sect.pl:
Świece są rzeczywiście zapalone.
Przynajmniej niektóre.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_chandelier/Sect.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_fireplace/Secti.en: I guess [h]this[/h] is what lights up the room when you pull the switch.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_fireplace/Secti.pl: Zgaduję, że [h]to[/h] rozświetla pokój, kiedy pociągniesz za dźwignię.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_fireplace/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_fireplace/Secti.en: I wonder what they burn to make it pink?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_fireplace/Secti.pl: Zastanawiam się, co palą, żeby było różowe?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_fireplace/Secti.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_furniture/Secti.en: If we end up having to stay the night.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_furniture/Secti.pl: Jeśli w końcu będziemy musieli zostać na noc.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_furniture/Secti.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_furniture/Secti.en: Sally - we are [h]not[/h] staying overnight on the [h]murder submarine.[/h]
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_furniture/Secti.pl: Sally - [h]nie[/h] zostajemy na noc na [h]łodzi podwodnej morderstwa.[/h]
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_furniture/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ladder/Section.en: It's the ladder leading back up to the fore deck.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ladder/Section.pl: To drabina prowadząca z powrotem na pokład dziobowy.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_ladder/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_switch/Section.en: This is the lever you pulled?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_switch/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_switch/Section.pl: Tak, więc zostaw ją w spokoju.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_switch/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_switch/Section.en: I don't want it to go dark again.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_switch/Section.pl: Nie chcę, żeby znów zrobiło się ciemno.
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_switch/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_GrippHasEscaped.en: Gripp can't have gone up to the Fore Deck, it's still locked. Which way did he go?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_GrippHasEscaped.pl: Gripp nie mógł pójść na Pokład Dziobowy, wciąż jest zamknięty. W którą stronę poszedł?
Examine/Exam_Area_Parlor_GrippHasEscaped.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

do_pozniejszej_weryfikacji.issue: Angielska gra slowna 'drawing room' -> 'withdrawing room' (etymologia 'pokoj do wycofywania sie') nieprzekladalna doslownie na polski 'salon' - przetlumaczona funkcjonalnie z zachowaniem sensu wyjasnienia, ale bez analogicznej gry slownej w jezyku polskim.
